name: Juunigatsu no Paska
source:
A boy left alone in a bloody living room is sent to a facility without a destination. It became.
Even there, he couldn't find his whereabouts and spent his time alone. Until one day he caught a cheerful smile like spring in his eyes.

The fate of the two who should not have crossed goes back to the past and crosses. A novel game depicting

"spring and winter,"
"body and soul,"
"desire and thirst," and
"true love ." A dark love story of a boy and a girl holding hands in the snowy city of Shibuya.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/481]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
被独自留在血染客厅里的少年，无处可去，最终被送进了一所收容机构。即便在那里，他也找不到自己的归属，只是独自度过每一天。直到某日，一抹如春日般明朗的笑容，映入他的眼中。

本不该交汇的两人，命运溯回过去，彼此交错。这部文字冒险描绘的是——

“春与冬”，
“肉体与灵魂”，
“欲望与渴求”，
以及“真爱”。

在飘雪的涩谷街头，一对少年少女牵起彼此的手，一段黑暗的爱情故事就此展开。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/481]NovelGame[/url]]
